reviewer_statement: Developer-side six-domain native-language full-source semantic review against frozen Python 1.2. Typed WorkflowStepRecord and WorkflowDecisionRecord, complete source table columns, representative accepted/error boundaries, and direct pandas differential output evidence. R lists/data.frames and Python dataclass/pandas objects have different runtime identities; exception class identities and arbitrary Python protocols are not claimed. Independent certification is not obtained.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native R ordered list records and named decision list are explicitly validated semantic analogues of source frozen Python dataclasses and mapping protocol. Named R lists represent Python JSON mapping and unnamed lists sequences; source Boolean elapsed_seconds is converted to float. R data.frame is the Python pandas semantic counterpart; class identity and arbitrary Python custom object protocols are not a native R objective.

case_evidence.description: Source Python accepts Sequence[WorkflowStepRecord] or Mapping[str,WorkflowDecisionRecord]; R native validated list equivalents and exact output signatures
Empty and populated ordered records; Python Boolean elapsed seconds; recursive Unicode and ndarray JSON; null, numeric, bool and empty mapping values
Direct frozen Python 1.2 typed dataclass/pandas comparison across empty, mixed step statuses/decision sources, Boolean elapsed seconds and NumPy 2D tensor axes
Reject nonfinite/negative/NA step time, unknown statuses and decision sources, duplicated mapping keys, missing audited selector criteria, invalid numerical values
Exact eight ordered steps table fields and four decision fields, row counts, sorted JSON, warnings and missing criterion semantics
Only descriptive audit records and decisions; no estimation, automatic preprocessing or scientific model selection; native S3 analogue remains separate from Python class identity

independent_review_status: developer-reviewed only; independent reviewer and cross-platform latest-head CI pending
language_specific_limits: Python pandas/dataclass identities are not identical to R data.frame/list types
Python TypeError and ValueError map to native R conditions with semantic boundaries
Arbitrary Python mapping, NumPy object-array and user-defined protocols are not native R representations
